item.title: ❗️ 270 Russian servicemen returned from Kiev regime's territory In exchange, 270 AFU prisoners of war were transferred.
item.description: ❗️ 270 Russian servicemen returned from Kiev regime's territory In exchange, 270 AFU prisoners of war were transferred. as of 17-23 October 2026

🚩
During the week, the Tsentr Group's units have liberated Dobropolye, Pervomayskoye, and Sergeyevka (Donetsk People's Republic) as a result of active actions.
💥
Strikes have been delivered at
formations of five mechanised brigades, one assault brigade, one jaeger brigade, one air assault brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, one marine brigade, five national guard brigades, and the Azov Special Operations Brigade.
▪️
In total, more than 2,405 troops, 44 armoured fighting vehicles, 53 motor vehicles, 16 field artillery guns, and 15 electronic warfare stations have been neutralised in the Tsentr Group's area of responsibility.
🚩
Over the past week, the Vostok Group's units have continued to advance to the depths of the enemy's defence and, as a result of decisive actions, have liberated Omelnik, Timoshevka, Chervony Yar and Mirovka (Zaporozhye region) and established control over the settlement of Velikomikhaylovka (Dnepropetrovsk region).
💥
Strikes were delivered at
manpower and hardware
of two mechanised brigades, one airmobile brigade, three air assault brigades, two assault regiments of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and one marine brigade. The enemy losses in this direction amounted to more than 1,380 troops, 22 armoured fighting vehicles, 38 motor vehicles, and two field artillery guns.
🚩
Last week, the Dnepr Group's units improved the tactical situation and liberated Malokaterinovka and Yulyevka (Zaporozhye region).
💥
Russian elements have inflicted losses on
manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, one mountain assault brigade, one assault regiment of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, and one marine brigade.
▪️
Up to 215 troops, four armoured fighting vehicles, 127 motor vehicles, one artillery gun, and eight electronic warfare stations have been neutralised.
▫️
Air defence systems shot down
five guided aerial bombs, three U.S.-made HIMARS MLRS projectiles, seven Flamingo long-range cruise missiles, and 5,593 fixed-wing UAVs.
⚓️
The Black Sea Fleet eliminated
five uncrewed surface vehicles of the Ukrainian Navy
in the Black Sea waters.
📊
In total, since the beginning of the special military operation, the enemy has lost:

674

▫️
1,792
MLRS fighting vehicles,
▫️
36,794
field artillery guns and mortars,
▫️
75,380
support military wheeled vehicles.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ❗️ From 17 to 23 October, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation carried out three massive and 11 group strikes,
item.description: ❗️ From 17 to 23 October, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation carried out three massive and 11 group strikes, which hit enterprises of the defence industry, logistics centres, power and transport infrastructure facilities used in the interests of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, medium- and long-range UAV manufacturing workshops and depots, military hardware depots, and temporary deployment areas of Ukrainian armed formations and foreign mercenaries. 💥 In addition, the Ukrainian ports' infrastructure facilities, which were used to provide reception, storing and distribution of military cargo, have been disabled. 💥 During the week, 14 dry cargo ships and container ships supplying weapons, military hardware, and dual-use cargo to the Armed Forces of Ukraine were hit. ▫️ The Sever Group's units have completed neutralisation of the encircled enemy in the north-eastern part of Kharkov region and continue to eliminate the enemy's solo groups. 📍 During the week, units of the Sever Group of Forces improved the situation along the front line. item.title: 👊 Tsentr's strike force: marines share details of the liberation of Dobropolye During the liberation of the city, fighters of the 61st Marine Brigade and the 177th Marine Regiment
item.description: Tsentr's strike force: marines share details of the liberation of Dobropolye 👊 During the liberation of the city, fighters of the 61st Marine Brigade and the 177th Marine Regiment of the Tsentr Group of Forces employed infiltration tactics and building-up assault groups to create a strike fist. ✂️ The marines began cutting off the enemy's supply routes around Dobropolye back in May, before forward detachments entered the city. Fire teams blocked the delivery of ammunition and reserves of the AFU from the neighbouring settlements of Svyatogorovka, Annovka and Belozyorskoye. 🔥 The infantry's advance was supported daily by artillerymen and drone operators. They fired on enemy positions and fortifications both in Dobropolye itself and on its outskirts. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 🏎 Formula 1 of the skies The new F-1 interceptor drone has been used for the first time
item.description: 🏎 Formula 1 of the skies The new F-1 interceptor drone has been used for the first time by the Tsentr Group's anti-aircraft missile brigade. In four days, drone teams neutralised more than 20 AFU strike drones . 📍 Dnepropetrovsk direction 'Good streamlining, wing aerodynamics, more stable. Good manufacturing material. Upgraded engine and regulator. Smaller form, comparatively light weight, but despite its lightness, it behaves quite steadily and is stable in any weather,' the team leader noted. This drone has shown high effectiveness in neutralising high-speed targets. F-1 drone intercepts enemy reconnaissance and strike UAVs before they get a chance to attack the positions of our troops. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
